name: Hotel Tiefenbrunner
beschreibung: Hotel Tiefenbrunner looks back on centuries of hospitality right in the historic heart of Kitzbühel. The hotel masterfully pairs authentic Tyrolean craftsmanship with modern alpine luxury. Beautifully appointed rooms and suites provide a serene retreat following outdoor adventures in the Kitzbühel Alps. Guests enjoy an extensive wellness area featuring an indoor swimming pool, sauna world, and soothing relaxation rooms. The on-site restaurant serves celebrated regional specialties alongside international culinary creations. Located directly in the pedestrian zone, cable cars, designer boutiques, and historic sights are only steps away.
kurzbeschreibung: Historic heritage hotel in central Kitzbühel featuring Tyrolean hospitality and wellness facilities.
